description: Prepare monthly pay apps from the schedule of values for 22 projects; submit to owners and federal invoicing portals; apply cash receipts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $7.8 million billed a month, 15 of 22 pay apps due in the last 5 business days of the month; missing an owner's cutoff delays cash a full cycle; integrity: one redirected owner payment averages about $1.2 million and is rarely recovered; a federal payment sent to incorrect EFT data the contractor supplied is the contractor's loss (FAR 52.232-33(e)(2))
manual_workaround: Prepare pay apps from the last ERP export and job-cost spreadsheets; submit through owner portals; confirm any remittance question only by call-back to a number already on file
dependent_third_parties: ERP vendor; owners; federal paying offices; bank
dependent_people_or_facilities: Controller; 4 billing staff; Project Managers; headquarters
quantified_operational_impact: 22 pay apps a month; a missed cycle delays about $7.8 million of cash by about 30 days
quantified_regulatory_impact: Federal invoices filed late; no penalty, but Prompt Payment interest is not earned
contract_or_regulatory_linkage: FAR 52.232-5; FAR 52.232-33; prime contract payment terms

description: Approve subcontractor invoices against pay apps; build ACH batches; release payments; collect lien waivers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $5.2 million a month to about 450 subcontractors and suppliers; on federal jobs, payment within 7 days of receipt (FAR 52.232-27(c)(1)) with interest penalties; late payment invites liens and stopped work; integrity: a fraudulent bank change diverts a whole progress payment
manual_workaround: Manual ACH in the bank portal from the last approved batch; checks with positive pay; call-back to a number on file before any changed bank detail is used
quantified_operational_impact: About 900 payments a month in 2 weekly ACH runs
quantified_regulatory_impact: Interest penalties on late federal subcontractor payments (FAR 52.232-27); lien exposure on private projects

description: Drawings, specifications, RFIs, submittals, and change orders for 22 jobsites through SYS-01
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 1,800 workers a day (318 company craft plus subcontractor crews) build from current sheets; a day without RFI and submittal flow cuts field productivity by about 20% (about $75,000 of $376,000 construction revenue per day); superseded sheets cause rework
manual_workaround: Offline sets on rugged tablets (current as of last sync); printed sets in each trailer; phone and email RFIs logged for later entry
dependent_third_parties: Project management platform vendor; design teams; cellular carriers
quantified_operational_impact: About 140 RFIs and 260 submittals move each week across 22 jobsites
quantified_regulatory_impact: Contract response times for RFIs and submittals; schedule claims if the company causes the delay
safety_impact_detail: Moderate: crews may build from superseded structural or fire-stopping details
contract_or_regulatory_linkage: Prime contract submittal and RFI procedures

description: Receive Government CUI drawings; exchange CUI design packages with the A&E subcontractor; distribute CUI to 14 trade subcontractors; control printed CUI at the FC-4 jobsite
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: FC-4 earns about $60,000 a working day; CUI may be handled only on systems that meet DFARS 252.204-7012; when the enclave is slow or unavailable, staff fall back to the commercial platform, which is how the CUI spill began
manual_workaround: Printed CUI sets in the locked FC-4 plan cabinet; CUI transmittals wait for the enclave; never SYS-01 or personal email for CUI
dependent_systems: SYS-07; SYS-09 (enclave laptops); SYS-04 (corporate sign-in to reach the enclave desktops)
dependent_third_parties: Government-community cloud provider; A&E subcontractor; Army Corps of Engineers
dependent_people_or_facilities: FC-4 Project Executive; 41 company enclave users; FC-4 trailer
quantified_operational_impact: About 6,800 CUI sheets and documents; about 120 CUI transmittals a month
quantified_regulatory_impact: Handling CUI on an unauthorized system must be assessed as a possible cyber incident and reported within 72 hours if confirmed (DFARS 252.204-7012(c)(1)); loss of CMMC Level 2 eligibility for the follow-on MATOC

description: Quantity takeoffs, pricing, subcontractor bid leveling, and proposal submission, including federal proposals
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Bid due times are fixed and late bids are rejected; about 6 major bids a month; the expected margin lost on one missed bid is about $300,000 (win rate about 25%, margin about 6% on a $20 million bid); MTD applies in bid week and relaxes to 72 hours otherwise
manual_workaround: Estimate from the prior day's database export and spreadsheets; upload or hand-deliver the bid from any managed device
dependent_systems: SYS-06 (estimating database); SYS-05; SYS-04; SYS-14; AI-001
dependent_people_or_facilities: Director of Preconstruction; 17 estimators and preconstruction staff
quantified_operational_impact: About 6 major bids a month; about $1.4 billion submitted a year
quantified_regulatory_impact: Federal proposals must arrive through the named portal by the stated time

description: Weekly craft payroll, biweekly salaried payroll, and weekly certified payrolls for federal jobs
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: 318 craft are paid weekly; weekly certified payrolls on 4 federal contracts (FAR 52.222-8(b)(1)); missed pay harms workers and retention in a tight labor market
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll through the payroll vendor's support line; prepare certified payrolls from time-clock exports
quantified_operational_impact: 318 weekly and 282 biweekly paychecks; about 9 certified payrolls a week
quantified_regulatory_impact: Weekly certified payrolls (FAR 52.222-8(b)(1)); payroll records kept 3 years after contract completion (FAR 52.222-8(a))

description: Daily logs, quality inspections, time capture, visitor sign-in, and inspection scheduling
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Daily logs and inspection records are contract deliverables; time capture feeds payroll; visitor logs support physical access requirements
manual_workaround: Paper daily logs, time sheets, and visitor logs; enter later
dependent_third_parties: Project management platform vendor; time-clock service
quantified_operational_impact: 22 daily logs and about 1,800 time entries a day
quantified_regulatory_impact: Daily logs and visitor records are contract deliverables on federal jobs
safety_impact_detail: Moderate: inspection holds may be missed

description: Pre-task plans, hot work and confined space permits, inspections, incident reports, and OSHA records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: High-risk work needs a current permit and pre-task plan; incident records feed OSHA reporting
manual_workaround: Paper permit books and pre-task plan forms in every trailer; OSHA reports by telephone
dependent_people_or_facilities: Director of Safety; 8 safety managers; superintendents
quantified_operational_impact: About 90 permits and 22 pre-task plans a day
quantified_regulatory_impact: OSHA reporting of a fatality within 8 hours and of an in-patient hospitalization, amputation, or loss of an eye within 24 hours (29 CFR 1904.39(a)) does not depend on company systems (telephone or the OSHA website)
safety_impact_detail: Severe: crews could start high-risk work without a permit or pre-task plan if paper backups are not used

description: Build wall panels, door frames, and MEP racks from BIM models for jobsites
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The shop ships about $40,000 of components a day; jobsites hold about 3 days of buffer
manual_workaround: Build from the last downloaded shop drawings; shift crews to field work

description: Install and configure client video surveillance, access control, network, and BAS equipment; hand over credentials
process_owner: Director of Technology and Security Systems
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Commissioning dates tie to owner move-in; client credentials must be available during installation and warranty; federal submittals need Section 889 screening
manual_workaround: Delay commissioning; use manufacturer reset procedures with the client present
dependent_systems: SYS-13 (credential vault); SYS-09 (commissioning laptops); SYS-05; SYS-01
quantified_regulatory_impact: No covered equipment may be provided on federal jobs (FAR 52.204-25(b)(1))

description: 24x7 health monitoring, alarm triage, and remote administration of video, access control, and BAS at 38 client sites
process_owner: Director of Technology and Security Systems
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: MBSS agreements require response to critical alerts within 1 hour; after about 4 hours, failed cameras or door controllers at hospitals and schools go unnoticed and SLA credits apply (10% of the monthly fee, about $50,000 a month across all clients); two clients require SOC 2 Type 2 by 2027-12-31
manual_workaround: Client security staff watch their own consoles; MBSS technicians call clients and dispatch on site; the client's own remote access as a last resort (with client approval)
dependent_people_or_facilities: 8 MBSS technicians; MBSS monitoring room at headquarters
quantified_operational_impact: 38 client sites, about 9,400 monitored devices, about 60 critical alerts a month
quantified_regulatory_impact: Contractual SLAs only; client facility security details must stay confidential
safety_impact_detail: Moderate: an undetected door controller or camera failure at a client site

description: Track location, hours, and maintenance for 140 pieces of heavy equipment and 160 vehicles
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Maintenance intervals and theft recovery; not time-critical
manual_workaround: Paper hour logs; superintendents confirm locations by phone
dependent_people_or_facilities: Equipment and Fleet Manager; yard staff

business_process: Contract administration and federal compliance reporting
description: SAM registration, SPRS entries, Section 889 reports, DIBNet cyber incident reports, contract modifications
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Section 889 reports are due within 1 business day of identification (FAR 52.204-25(d)(2)(i)); DFARS cyber incident reports within 72 hours of discovery (252.204-7012(c)(1)(ii)); SAM registration must stay active for payment
manual_workaround: Report from any managed device that holds a valid medium assurance certificate (none valid today; gap 8); telephone the Contracting Officer
dependent_people_or_facilities: Director of Contracts and Compliance; 2 contracts staff
quantified_regulatory_impact: A missed 72-hour DFARS report or 1-business-day Section 889 report is a contract compliance failure

business_process: Subcontractor prequalification, onboarding, and vendor master setup
description: Prequalify subcontractors; issue subcontracts with flowdowns; set up vendor master and bank details
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Integrity of bank details captured at onboarding; FAR and DFARS clause flowdown at subcontract award
manual_workaround: Hold new subcontract awards; paper prequalification packets; no bank details accepted until systems return and call-back is done
dependent_people_or_facilities: Controller; Director of Contracts and Compliance; 2 contracts staff
quantified_operational_impact: About 35 new subcontractors and suppliers a month

description: Applicant tracking, background checks, onboarding, safety and security training records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: High craft turnover (about 200 craft hires a year); training records support safety and CUI access
dependent_third_parties: Payroll and HR vendor; background check vendor

description: Clash detection, coordination models, and shop drawing models on the BIM/CAD file servers and GPU virtual desktops
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Coordination meetings run weekly; the 2026-03 restore test of the BIM/CAD servers took 10 hours
manual_workaround: Design teams hold model copies; local copies on VDC workstations
dependent_systems: SYS-06 (BIM/CAD servers, GPU virtual desktops); SYS-04

description: Monthly close, work-in-progress schedules, and reports to the lender, the private equity sponsor, and the surety
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Quarterly lender and surety reporting covenants; not time-critical within a week
manual_workaround: Close from ERP exports when restored
